plugin.name: NEKO Sisters: Survivors
plugin.description: A bullet-heaven survival roguelite bundled inside the plugin: dodge with WASD, weapons fire automatically, collect, upgrade and synthesize, and survive 20 waves. Open the panel and play. Nightmare difficulty hides a secret boss. The catgirl auto-reports your run in the chat.
entries.game_event.name: Game event report
entries.game_event.description: Receives in-game events (waves/bosses/results) and lets the official catgirl react in chat. Called automatically by the game page, with rate limiting built in.
